const glassInput = {
  width: "100%",
  padding: "14px",
  marginBottom: "14px",
  borderRadius: "12px",
  border: "1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.2)",
  background: "rgba(255,255,255,0.1)",
  color: "white",
  outline: "none",
  fontSize: "15px"
};

const primaryBtn = {
  width: "100%",
  padding: "13px",
  background: "#2563eb",
  border: "none",
  borderRadius: "12px",
  color: "white",
  cursor: "pointer",
  marginBottom: "14px",
  fontWeight: "600"
};

const warningBtn = {
  width: "100%",
  padding: "13px",
  background: "#f59e0b",
  border: "none",
  borderRadius: "12px",
  color: "white",
  cursor: "pointer",
  marginBottom: "14px",
  fontWeight: "600"
};

const registerBtn = {
  width: "100%",
  padding: "14px",
  background:
    "linear-gradient(90deg,#06b6d4,#3b82f6)",
  border: "none",
  borderRadius: "12px",
  color: "white",
  fontSize: "16px",
  cursor: "pointer",
  marginTop: "10px",
  fontWeight: "700"
};

const featureBox = {
  background: "rgba(255,255,255,0.15)",
  padding: "15px 25px",
  borderRadius: "15px",
  backdropFilter: "blur(10px)"
};
